components.notes: Low6x6m soil patch,3m-wide flat compacted tanearth path crossesN/S throughmidpoints; darksoft woodland humus either side, faintleaflitter/pebbles only, no tallplants/trees, clean equalheight boundary ports. All four named sections are present. The revised S03 top view shows a T junction with its south edge closed by soil; the rejected crossing remains archived. The proposed patch extent is 6 m, walking lane width 3 m and substrate depth 0.5 m. Port centres and widths are construction intent, not measurements from the drawing. Place the soil side faces below surrounding terrain. S04’s blue water is context, not a separate water asset. Edge heights, bank slopes, textures, seams and collision clearance remain unverified. Large landforms should use sculpting or heightfields; these are local trail appearance references.
